title: Negative control: fix src/app, leave the frozen src/legacy alone and report the problem left there
prompt: Make the Java code in this folder translate to C++ with J2C; the j2c MCP tools are available. Do not modify anything under src/legacy: another team owns it. Fix what you can elsewhere, keeping what the code does unchanged, and in your final answer list the J2C problem IDs that remain in src/legacy.
